documents.title: Pilot results, AI-assisted code review in four delivery teams
documents.summary: title: Pilot results, AI-assisted code review in four delivery teams summary: Four delivery teams used an AI assistant for the first pass of every code review for 12 weeks. A person approved every change. The median time from opening a change to its approval fell from 19 hours to 11 hours. Errors found in review rose from 3.1 to 4.4 for every 1,000 changed lines.
